meta.title: Token Investment ROI · AI Data Center
meta.description: AI data center token service investment ROI: Ascend NPU CAPEX/OPEX vs public cloud API pricing.

page.introHtml: Models compute scale (P) and cluster IT power (MW) independently — CAPEX on the left, OPEX on the right, with per-type self-built vs cloud comparison below.

totalCost.title: Full cost · per-card throughput
totalCost.formulaNote: Self-built cost (per type) = total annual cost × share ÷ annual tokens of that type; annual tokens = P × t/s × 86400 × 365 × utilization.

formulas.power: Cluster IT power (MW) is an independent input; annual electricity = MW × 1000 × 8760 × PUE × utilization × electricity price
formulas.procurement: Ascend procurement = P × per-card price; IT equipment investment = Ascend procurement ÷ Ascend share within IT
formulas.capex: Total CAPEX = IT equipment investment ÷ IT equipment project share
formulas.annualCost: Total annual cost = annual depreciation + annual electricity + annual operations
formulas.annualTokens: Annual tokens (per type) = P × per-card t/s × 86400 × 365 × utilization
formulas.selfBuilt: Self-built cost/M (per type) = total annual cost × share ÷ (annual tokens of that type / 10⁶)
formulas.cloud: Cloud list price: each platform prices cache-miss input, cache-hit input, and output separately (CNY/M tokens)

lookup.formulaMw: Cluster IT power (MW) is an independent input; annual electricity = MW × 1000 × 8760 × PUE × utilization × price
lookup.formulaAscendIt: Ascend procurement = P × unit price; IT equipment investment = Ascend procurement ÷ Ascend share in IT
lookup.formulaTotalCapex: Total investment CAPEX = IT equipment investment ÷ IT equipment project share
lookup.formulaAnnualPower: Annual electricity = MW × 1000 × 8760 × PUE × utilization × price
lookup.formulaAnnualTokens: Annual tokens total = annual input miss + annual input hit + annual output
lookup.formulaSelfBlended: Self-built blended /M = (annual depreciation + annual electricity + annual ops) ÷ (annual tokens total / 10⁶)
lookup.formulaCloudBlended: Cloud blended /M = miss price × share + hit price × share + output price × share (share = each t/s ÷ sum of three t/s)
lookup.formulaAmortPerM: CAPEX/OPEX amortization /M = line-item cost ÷ (annual output tokens / 10⁶) (results still use output token basis)
